_about: FOOTFX v1 (FootFx.cs). enabled=false ships dark (-footfx:1 forces on). surfaces[] rows keyed by id; the surface of a zone is the optional 'surface' field on zone_ground_mat.json rows. Sizes are metres at creature scale 1 (x lossyScale.y x sizeMul x (1 + speedBoost*speed/speedRef)). colour = sRGB 0..1 vertex colour, alpha = peak alpha. gravity = ParticleSystem gravityModifier (negative rises). grow = end size / start size. cooldown = s per foot. maxPerSecond = bursts per second per surface (all creatures). footBones = bone-name suffixes (case-insensitive); the log prints 'bound <name>: n feet' per creature, extend this list for quadruped monster rigs. plantY/liftY = foot bone height above the creature root at scale 1: armed above liftY, footfall when it drops under plantY while the creature moves >= minSpeedMps. waterNames = collider name fragments that count as water (down-ray, waterRayM); waterSurface is used then, or when a zone row has waterY and the foot is below it. defaultSurface applies where no zone row has a surface. testBurst=true puffs at the player's feet every testEverySec (harness).
